# Super Técnico

Super Técnico is a Spanish technical knowledge project for HVAC, electronics, components, real repair cases, and electrical diagrams. It is preparing a provider-neutral machine service designed to reduce search, context, token usage, and unsupported technical claims.

## Current machine status

- Public discovery and design contracts: available
- Remote knowledge API: not active
- Remote MCP server: not active
- Commercial machine access: not open
- Local ElectroIA MCP source: private-preview development only

Do not call planned endpoints until discovery.json reports remote execution as enabled. Public JSON files contain metadata and contracts, not credentials.

## Super Técnico AI entry points

- Human-readable integration overview: /ia-integracion.html
- Product discovery: /data/ai/discovery.json
- Proposed AI tools and input schemas: /data/ai/tool-manifest.json
- Traceable knowledge-record schema: /data/ai/knowledge-record.schema.json
- Non-executable OpenAPI design contract: /data/ai/knowledge-api-contract.openapi.json
- Machine-readiness report: /data/ai/readiness-report.json
- Economic benchmark plan: /data/ai/benchmark-plan.json
- Viability roadmap for 16 machine tools: /data/ai/tool-strategy.json
- Storage and cache policy: /data/ai/storage-policy.json

## Intended machine workflow

1. Check coverage before requesting a full answer.
2. Request only the smallest sufficient result level: basic, diagnostic, field, or diagram.
3. Preserve brand, family, model, unit scope, and display location so variants are not mixed.
4. Treat stable IDs, record versions, confidence, evidence, warnings, and unknowns as part of the answer.
5. Never infer that missing data is confirmed data and never attempt bulk extraction.

## ElectroIA diagram entry points

- Discovery manifest: /data/electroia/discovery.json
- Tool manifest: /data/electroia/tool-manifest.json
- Neutral diagram JSON Schema: /data/electroia/diagram-document.schema.json
- Normalized symbol library: /data/electroia/symbol-library.json
- Symbol quality report: /data/electroia/symbol-normalization-report.json
- Read-only OpenAPI discovery: /data/electroia/discovery.openapi.json
- MCP Registry metadata draft: /electroia-tool-server/server.json
- Source repository: https://github.com/replacor-gif/super-tecnico

For diagrams, the calling AI interprets the request or image, chooses the topology, calculates values, and selects components. ElectroIA validates symbols, terminals, and nets and renders a deterministic single-canvas SVG.

## Frigorista entry points

- Human tool: /frigorista.html
- Discovery manifest: /data/frigorista/discovery.json
- Proposed AI tools and schemas: /data/frigorista/tool-manifest.json
- Versioned refrigerant catalog: /data/frigorista/catalog.json

The browser engine already performs deterministic P/T, superheat and subcooling calculations. Remote API and MCP execution remain planned; do not call them until discovery reports them as enabled.

## Regulation search entry points

- Human search tool: /normativa.html
- Versioned official-document catalog: /data/regulations/catalog.json
- Machine contract: /data/regulations/tool-manifest.json

The browser can search the stored official Spanish regulations and return the source document, page and official URL. Search hits are documentary evidence, not automatic legal conclusions. Consolidated BOE texts must be checked against the official publication and the applicable regional or local rules. UNE and IEC texts are not redistributed without a suitable licence.
The regulation catalog includes binary and semantic source fingerprints. AI consumers must distinguish raw document hits, reviewed rules and deterministic results. When an official source changes semantically, dependent rules and calculators remain pending review until explicitly validated.

## Condensate drain entry points

- Human sizing tool: /desagues-condensados.html
- Browser calculation engine: /assets/condensate-drain-engine.js
- Machine contract: /data/condensate/tool-manifest.json

The browser engine accumulates condensate flow from the furthest unit to the outlet and sizes each gravity segment using explicit assumptions. Prefer measured or manufacturer flow. Manufacturer connection size remains a minimum. Remote execution is planned and is not currently enabled.
